title: A Clock Timed by the Sun
paragraphs: Optical clocks, the most precise timekeepers ever built, normally owe their accuracy to atoms isolated from the outside world: an electron inside an atom is made to oscillate between two energy levels, an ultra-stable laser is locked to the frequency of that oscillation, and a device called a frequency comb converts the rapid light waves into microwaves that ordinary electronics can count as ticks. Researchers led by Scott Diddams at the University of Colorado, Boulder, have now built a version in which the atomic reference is replaced by something that occurs at the sun itself.

Instead of locking their laser to an electron's jumps inside a laboratory atom, the team locked it to a process in which sunlight causes comparable jumps as it strikes iron atoms in the solar atmosphere. That process leaves a signature in the spectrum of colours that make up sunlight, so the researchers channelled sunlight into a special fibre and fed it into the rest of the apparatus. A clock of this kind has never been constructed before. It does not rival the best atomic optical clocks in accuracy, but during the partial solar eclipse of 2024 the team observed a characteristic shift in the spectrum as the moon passed in front of the sun, which suggests that such a device could serve as a tool for studying stars.

Fed with light from a distant star, the same design might indicate the presence of orbiting exoplanets through similar shifts, although starlight would have to be gathered by large telescopes, sometimes over long periods. Piet Schmidt, of the National Metrology Institute of Germany, welcomed the work because it draws on light from the stars rather than on objects kept under tight laboratory control, yet he cautioned that as an astronomical instrument it does not yet surpass existing methods, and that for very faint, distant stars its usefulness would be severely limited. He sees better prospects closer to home, where the clock might probe eruptions, sunspots and the solar wind in the outer layers of the sun's atmosphere.

questions.prompt: Which statement best expresses the main idea of the passage?

options.text: A clock referenced to the sun has matched laboratory clocks, because sunlight replaces the laser that normally sets the reference frequency.
options.explanation: Yeni saat da lazer kullanır ve en iyi atomik optik saatlerle rekabet etmez; yalnızca atomik referansın yerini güneşteki bir süreç alır.

options.text: A clock referenced to the sun has found exoplanets, because the 2024 eclipse produced the same spectral shift that orbiting planets cause.
options.explanation: Tutulma, güneş ışığında bir kayma gösterdi; yıldız ışığıyla ötegezegen saptama olası bir uygulama olarak sunulur.

options.text: A clock referenced to the sun has replaced the frequency comb, because sunlight can be counted directly by ordinary electronics.
options.explanation: Frekans tarağı ışık dalgalarını elektroniğin sayabileceği mikrodalgalara çeviren bileşendir ve saatte yerinde kalır.

options.text: A clock referenced to the sun is less accurate than laboratory clocks, but shifts in its sunlight suggest uses in astronomy.
options.explanation: İlk iki paragraf güneşteki bir sürece dayanan saati, üçüncü paragraf astronomik kullanımını ve en iyi olanağın Güneş'in incelenmesinde olduğunu anlatır.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the reference to the partial solar eclipse of 2024?

options.text: To demonstrate that the clock keeps accurate time even when part of the sunlight is blocked from reaching it.
options.explanation: Gözlenen şey saatin zaman tutması değil, spektrumdaki kaymadır.

options.text: To show that the spectral change the clock relies on can be seen to vary, which hints at uses in astronomy.
options.explanation: Ay güneşin önünden geçerken spektrumda karakteristik bir kayma gözlenir; bu, aygıtın yıldızları incelemek için kullanılabileceğini düşündürür.

options.text: To explain why the clock outperforms atomic optical clocks whenever the light it receives is changing.
options.explanation: Saatin en iyi atomik optik saatlerle rekabet etmediği aynı paragrafta söylenir.

options.text: To justify the need for large telescopes, which must gather light for long periods before any shift can be seen.
options.explanation: Büyük teleskoplar yıldız ışığı için ayrı bir bağlamda anılır; tutulma gözlemi bu konuya dayanak değildir.

questions.prompt: How far does Schmidt's approval of the new clock extend?

options.text: He endorses the clock as a replacement for current astronomical instruments, provided that starlight is gathered by large telescopes.
options.explanation: Schmidt bunun astronomik araç olarak mevcut yöntemleri henüz aşmadığını söyler; yerine geçeceği öne sürülmez.

options.text: He endorses the principle behind the design, but expects it to prove useless outside the laboratory.
options.explanation: Schmidt'in övgüsü laboratuvar dışına, yıldız ışığına dayanmasıyladır; kullanışsız olacağını değil, uzak sönük yıldızlarda sınırlı kalacağını söyler.

options.text: He endorses its practical performance, while questioning whether sunlight can serve as a reference at all.
options.explanation: Tersi doğrudur: ışığın referans olarak kullanılmasını olumlu bulur, performansı konusunda ise çekincelidir.

options.text: He endorses the idea of drawing on natural light, while limiting its practical value to the nearby sun rather than distant stars.
options.explanation: Schmidt tasarımın doğal ışığa dayanmasını olumlar, ancak uzak sönük yıldızlarda yararının sınırlı olduğunu ve en iyi olanağın Güneş atmosferinde olduğunu söyler.

questions.prompt: Which sentence is closest in meaning to the statement that the design 'draws on light from the stars rather than on objects kept under tight laboratory control'?

options.text: Its reference comes from natural light arriving from space, not from specially prepared and controlled laboratory systems.
options.explanation: 'Draws on light from the stars rather than on objects kept under tight laboratory control': referans doğal ışıktan alınır, özel hazırlanmış sistemlerden değil.

options.text: Its light comes from stars because laboratory objects cannot be controlled tightly enough to serve as a reference.
options.explanation: Laboratuvar nesnelerinin yeterince denetlenemediği söylenmez; tersine, sıkı denetim bu sistemleri değerli kılar.

options.text: Its accuracy comes from starlight being steadier than any object that can be held under laboratory control.
options.explanation: Yıldız ışığının laboratuvar nesnelerinden daha kararlı olduğu söylenmez; yeni saat en iyi atomik saatlerin doğruluğuna erişmez.

options.text: Its design uses stars only to check the readings of a clock that is otherwise built and controlled in a laboratory.
options.explanation: Işık yalnızca bir kontrol aracı değil, lazerin sabitlendiği referanstır.

sources.claim: Güneş ışığındaki demir atomu sıçramalarına sabitlenen ilk optik saat; frekans tarağı; 2024 kısmi tutulmasında gözlenen tayf kayması; Schmidt'in çekincesi.
